hypothesis: The boundary-only SIMD row clearing already verified in replicated kernels and complete sampled species-pair searches preserves accepted-hit checkpoints and every biological output of a fresh full OrthoBench pipeline, while potentially lowering computational cost.
scope: Complete 251378-gene, 12-proteome fresh initial HMM search, strict profile expansion, default refinement, satellite_v2 candidates, independently inferred species and gene trees, reconciliation and native exports. This is an initial complete-dataset kernel equivalence gate, not a replacement for the ongoing eight-endpoint accuracy program or independent generalization.
mechanism: Compile the same frozen hmm_viterbi.c with identical GCC -O3 -fopenmp -shared -fPIC -march=native flags; boundary_only additionally defines HMM_VITERBI_BOUNDARY_CLEAR_ONLY=1. Each arm has its own private source/library namespace. No installation or replacement of libraries used by existing jobs.
ordering: Use the committed opt-in canonical filename collection in BOTH arms to remove verified asynchronous block-arrival tie sensitivity. Its independent biological effects remain under evaluation in job 24240. Do not compare canonical outputs to historical arrival outputs as proof of kernel equivalence.
route_evidence: Use an identical benchmark-only CLI guard in both arms. Record actual multipair native calls and scored pair counts for initial search workers and profile scoring, the loaded private library identity, and reject silent scalar/Numba/CUDA fallbacks. Do not change kernel inputs, return values, graph rules or thresholds. Profile-build spawn workers use the unchanged alignment library; search workers inherit the guard via the existing fork pool.
equivalence_gate: Validate each arm's native outputs, complete gene universe and owner mapping using existing helpers. Require exact accepted-checkpoint manifests, graph/seed/candidate/membership products, RootHOGs, native pairs, confidence labels, rooted species tree and exported orthogroups. Require matching algorithmic counts and native reconciliation counts, excluding timing and environment metadata. Independently recompute OrthoBench F1, precision and recall for both. Investigate any difference rather than accepting matching F1 alone.
timing: Run full_clear then boundary_only sequentially with matched 16-CPU/64-GiB allocations, no cached HMM or tree reuse. Record stage and whole-run wall/CPU/RSS plus shared-host activity. One ordered fresh pair is output-equivalence evidence and descriptive cost only, not isolated or counterbalanced speed evidence. Kernel guard overhead applies to both arms.
selection: Advance only after exact full native output equivalence. Broader dataset confirmation and reproducible cost measurements remain required before default compile-flag promotion. Preserve the original full-clear default and all ongoing scientific runs.
git: Commit and push this plan before evaluation; test and freeze the guard/runner and pin source, inputs, scorers, tools, compiler, runtime and libraries. Commit and push launch and terminal evidence at subsequent milestones.
